records.description_rewritten: Houstrup Strand is a broad North Sea beach south-west of Nørre Nebel, with high dunes, designated parking and a southern stretch commonly used for nude bathing. It appears in two adult-meeting directories: Gays-Cruising lists it under Esbjerg, while Popcorn.dating places the same name under Nørre Nebel. Independent tourism guidance clearly places the beach in the Varde-area coast near Nørre Nebel, rather than central Esbjerg. The directories' descriptions are undated; a naturist beach is not itself evidence of recent sexual activity.
records.location_identity: Beach accessible from Houstrup Strandvej 31, 6830 Nørre Nebel. Master queue city Esbjerg should be corrected at later curation, not modified in the immutable queue.
records.access_conditions: Tourism source reports beach access via marked footpaths from Houstrup Strandvej parking, public toilet, southern naturist section roughly 500 metres south, no car entry to beach. Dune access and any protected nature rules apply. Strong offshore surf and rips; access paths not suitable for mobility-impaired visitors.

No dated firsthand cruising evidence was found in the accessible original material.
